notes.title: Dev Update – Pre-Alpha Almost Ready + Open Playtest Coming Soon
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone![/p][p]First, I want to thank everyone who is following the game — I really appreciate it! Rest assured, I’m putting all my effort into creating a game that’s fun and enjoyable for everyone.[/p][p]I'm excited to share my very first developer update with you! It’s been a long journey with a lot of hard work to get the game to this stage, and I’m happy to report that the first major development milestone is nearly complete. That means we’re almost ready to enter the pre-alpha stage — the first huge step for the project![/p][p][/p][h3]What does that mean?[/h3][p]The core prototype is nearly finished, with most major systems now functional and coming together. While there's still work to be done, there is already a playable version with around 30 minutes of gameplay. It still needs some polish, and I’d love to get people involved in shaping the game![/p][p][/p][h3]Open Playtest Coming Soon![/h3][p]To build the game we all want, the [b]first open playtest[/b] is coming very soon. This will be a great opportunity to give feedback and help shape the game — your input will be crucial in helping polish and improve it before we move forward.[/p][p][/p][h3]When?[/h3][p]We’ll be announcing the playtest date very soon. If this sounds like something you’d be interested in, please leave a comment on this update to show your support! The testing will be done through Steam using beta test keys.[/p][p][/p][p]I’m very happy to have reached this milestone. Thank you so much for your support and confidence in the game — more updates coming soon![/p][p][/p][p]/pepe[/p]
